what: in-PG A/B: theodb_symqg (co-located quantized-graph AM, own-code clean-room from arXiv:2411.12229) vs theodb_hnsw, SIFT1M, matched recall@10, same table/queries/groundtruth. Settles the per-hop random-page-read tax the off-PG spike could not.
hardware: DigitalOcean dedicated droplet, 8 vCPU, PostgreSQL 17.10 + pgrx 0.19.0, shared_buffers=2GB
reproduce: benchmarks/e2_symqg_inpg.py (N=1000000 NQ=200 DEGREE=32); best-of-3 warm QPS; recall@10 vs official GT
gate: theodb_symqg QPS >= 1.5x theodb_hnsw at matched recall@10 >= 0.95

v1_page_waste.note: v1 layout: one page (8KB) per 1408-byte row -> index 7828 MB (out-of-2GB-shared_buffers -> cold random page reads dominate). UNFAIR measurement (measured page-waste, not the algorithm).

v2_packed.note: v2 layout: fixed-size rows packed contiguously (CHUNK bytes/page, arithmetic addressing, no directory) -> index 1383 MB (5.66x smaller, fits 2GB shared_buffers -> warm). FAIR measurement.

verdict: gate NOT met; theodb_hnsw is 2.6-3.9x faster than theodb_symqg at matched recall (0.95-0.994) in-PG, warm. The page tax (risk #1) was real and dominant at first (v1: 8.5x loss), mitigable via contiguous packing (v2: down to 2.6-3.9x, +2.3x QPS, 5.66x smaller index), but a residual gap remains. The off-PG spike advantage (symqg 1.8-2.66x faster) did NOT transfer in-PG against the mature theodb_hnsw AM.
why: Even warm (fair size), each symqg beam-search hop decodes a 1408-byte co-located row (512B rotated vector + 32 neighbour sign-codes) and runs 32 scalar sign-estimates per pop, while theodb_hnsw hops a lean neighbour list with M35-M46 optimizations (copy-free with_page_item reads, SIMD distance). The first-cut symqg scan (per-hop Vec alloc, HashSet visited, f64 heaps) has had no optimization pass. The identified path to potentially close the gap is the FastScan 1-bit SIMD sign-estimate kernel (separate task, reuses vec/ah.rs ah_score_block) + copy-free row reads — matching the off-PG spike's promise, but that is separate scope.
correctness: theodb_symqg AM is functionally complete and correct: recall parity across the full sweep (0.857-0.9995), CREATE INDEX/scan/INSERT->pending/VACUUM/MVCC-delete all validated on real distinct SIFT1M data. Only the QPS gate is unmet.
